The threshold reads no labels, so it has no information advantage. The 95% CIs of the ratio include 1.0: T=0.25 [0.837, 1.134] and T=0.5 [0.980, 1.210]. The 25% CIs also include 1.0. So claim 2 is not_supported, and the confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: the only non-E01 entry is E21, which uses the same model, task and proxy as E01, differing only in temperature. It therefore can't trigger a kill. Its delta AUC is 0.010 and its neighbor ratios sit at the null, so nothing supports the claim either. The one ratio of 5.0 rests on 11 errors. Claim 3 stays open, and W3 is false.
